name: airship
tagline: A Figma-like visual editor for Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
description: airship puts a GUI layer on top of terminal coding agents, giving Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode a Figma-like visual editor. Instead of juggling raw terminal output, you get a visual canvas for steering and reviewing agent work. It is an early but promising window into what the next generation of coding-agent interfaces might look like.
highlights: Figma-inspired visual editor for terminal coding agents
Works across Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode
A GUI layer that makes agent sessions easier to steer and review
Early signal for the future of coding-agent interfaces
curatorNote: Coding agents live in the terminal today, but airship is part of the batch betting they grow a GUI. A clean visual layer over Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode is a bet worth tracking.
